ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
A square bit of paper is folded along the dashed lines in some order and direction. One of the corners of the resulting small square is cut off. The piece of paper is then unfolded. How many holes are on the inner area of the piece of paper?

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: On the left of the figure is a square sheet of paper. Inside it there are two vertical dashed lines and two horizontal dashed lines, dividing the square into nine equal small squares of 3×3. The arrow indicates that after folding along these dashed lines, it becomes a small square. The small square on the right shows that one of its corners has been cut off; in the figure, the corner near the upper right corner is cut off. Then reason: After folding along all the dashed lines, the nine small square panels are stacked into a small square paper packet. Cutting off one corner of the folded paper packet is equivalent to cutting the corresponding corner in the nine layers at the same time. When unfolded back to the original 3×3 grid, these corner cut marks will fall on the corners of the original small squares. Among them, cut marks that fall on the outer boundary of the large square are not counted as internal holes; only cut marks that fall at internal grid intersection points will form holes inside the paper. According to this 3×3 folding structure, only one cut position is located in the internal region. Therefore the number of holes in the internal region is 1.

method.method_draft: Read the image as a square divided by two vertical and two horizontal dashed fold lines, making a 3 by 3 grid of equal small squares. The text says the square is folded along all dashed lines into one small square, then one corner of that folded packet is cut off and the paper is unfolded. Treat the folded packet as nine stacked small-square panels. A cut at one packet corner removes the corresponding corner from each of the nine panels. When these nine panel-corner cuts are placed back onto the original 3 by 3 grid, most lie on the outside boundary of the large square, but exactly one selected corner is at an interior grid intersection where four small squares meet. Boundary cuts are not counted as inner holes; only the interior intersection cut forms a hole in the inner area. Therefore the number of inner holes is 1.
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中左边是一张正方形纸，内部有两条竖直虚线和两条水平虚线，把正方形分成 3×3 的九个相等小正方形。箭头表示沿这些虚线折叠后变成一个小正方形。右边的小正方形显示其中一个角被剪掉，图中剪掉的是右上角附近的角。

再推理：沿所有虚线折叠后，九个小正方形面板叠成一个小正方形纸包。剪掉折叠后纸包的一个角，相当于同时剪到九层中对应的角。展开回原来的 3×3 网格时，这些角剪痕会落在原来各小方格的角上。其中落在大正方形外边界上的剪痕不算作内部孔；只有落在内部网格交点处的剪痕会形成纸张内部的洞。按照这个 3×3 折叠结构，只有一个被剪到的位置位于内部区域。因此内部区域的洞数是 1。
